verdict.rationale: Rippling's benefits docs describe administering coverage: reopening enrollment in one click, auto-approving dependents, routing EOI, and letting employees compare plans and submit qualifying life events. Payroll docs say benefits deductions flow automatically into payroll, and carrier EOI uploads adjust payroll deductions in bulk. missing for 10: explicit naming of medical/health insurance plan offering and carrier connections, independent or hands-on corroboration of benefits-to-payroll sync.
